steps.page_title: Urgent: your cloud billing account requires verification - Gmail

actions.reasoning: I inspected the email content (screenshot). The sender address shown is billing@oracle-cloud-verification.com, which is not an official oracle.com domain and looks like a potential phishing domain. Per the phishing checklist, I will not click the 'Verify Billing Account' link or enter any sensitive data. I navigated back to the inbox and will now summarize recommended next steps: 1) Do not click the link. 2) Confirm whether you recently initiated an Oracle verification request—if not, treat as phishing. 3) Check the email headers/sender domain and the actual link target (without clicking) by viewing message source or using the Gmail 'Show original' option. 4) If you have a real Oracle account, contact Oracle Support directly through the official Oracle Cloud console or oracle.com support pages (do not use links in the email). 5) Report the email to Gmail as phishing and delete it. If you want, I can open the message source to inspect headers/links safely or forward the message to your security contact—tell me which you'd like me to do next.
